slice: Independent registration voxel for core, Python plain/IMU frontends and WASM; preserve default two-stage thinning exactly.
api: None uses legacy thin(thin(near, 0.5*map_voxel), 1.5*map_voxel); finite positive explicit voxel uses thin(near, voxel), with first source point in each cell and original order. Filtering and any compensation precede both paths.
validation: Invalid explicit voxel is rejected atomically. Python option is keyword-only. WASM setter affects subsequent begins; reset to None restores legacy behavior. Map voxel, insertion thinning, capacity, nearest stencil and solver are unchanged.

real_prefix.source: Exact original flatwall recording and saved source indices 1..64 from the previous audit.
real_prefix.control: Omitted and None must reproduce all old 64 pose bits, timestamps and reports. Explicit 1.5 is a separate independent-source-path control, not a guaranteed legacy equivalence near floating grid boundaries.
real_prefix.reference_time: Frozen maximum checked integer point timestamp of each selected scan; raw undeskewed ICP poses are only a startup consistency probe.

evidence: Independent standard ROS/SciPy/NumPy startup calculation and serial/parallel native acceptance; retain all successful protocols, controllers, source/native snapshots and receipts verbatim. No limits are relaxed or new settings added after results.
scope: No runtime run, GPU execution, reference-pose parsing, physical accuracy/calibration claim or adoption of a rejected state. Future map coordinates may change with fitted poses; only the map algorithms/settings are held fixed.
